notes: activateSlot's own doc comment (lines 643-648) numbers the steps: 1. auto-back-up the current world, 2. remove current folders, 3. unzip the new slot, 4. update lastPlayedAt. AppViewModel.activateWorldSlot (AppViewModel+WorldSlots.swift:231-234) always calls activateSlot with backupCurrent: true -- there is no UI path that skips the safety backup for an ordinary activation. The backup is not optional plumbing; it's the only recovery mechanism if extraction fails after the current folders are already gone (see activate-extraction-failure-leaves-partial-state-for-safety-backup-recovery).
